title: LA City General Fund postings, August 2025 vs August 2024

attempts.text: In August 2025, the General Fund postings decreased by 0.6% compared to August 2024, marking a reduction of $4.0 million. The Non-Departmental - Liability Claims posted $7.7 million in August 2025, down from $30.8 million in August 2024, indicating a decrease of $23.1 million. The Non-Departmental - General posted $121.1 million in August 2025, up from $104.5 million in August 2024, showing an increase of $16.6 million. The Fire activity saw an increase of $9.6 million in August 2025, up from $65.7 million in August 2024, indicating a rise of $23.3 million. The Public Works - Street Services activity experienced a decrease of $4.8 million in August 2025, down from $20.5 million in August 2024, showing a decrease of $4.8 million. Lastly, the Police activity showed an increase of $3.6 million in August 2025, up from $151.6 million in August 2024, indicating an increase of $3.6 million.
